summary: Odyssey Health, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the closing of a Master Technology and Sub-license Agreement with NeuRX Health, Inc., originally entered on October 14, 2025. The agreement grants Odyssey's wholly-owned subsidiary exclusive worldwide marketing and distribution rights to BreastCheck™, a non-invasive breast abnormality test. The filing also notes an Amendment No. 1 to effectuate the closing and a press release. No financial terms, price, premium, or board recommendation are disclosed. This is a routine licensing/distribution agreement closing, not a special-situations event like an acquisition or divestiture.
